This talk was prepared for the Data Lab for Social Good Summer School, The Art and Science of Uncertainty and the Future, held in Cardiff in July 2026. It presents the whole PhD in fifteen minutes.

Floods and rising sea levels keep disrupting how healthcare is delivered in Wales. Yet, we map where the water goes, not what stops working. The talk frames the project as one continuous argument about uncertainty. The first work package builds the missing evidence base with a multilingual text-mining pipeline and Welsh case studies. The second drivers of healthcare vulnerability to floods. The third plans for the uncertain futures using optimisation under uncertainty.
